technology_name: A CASCADED MODULAR EQUALIZER FOR BALANCING AN ULTRACAPACITOR BANK
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
technology_type: Power Electronics Grid / Energy Storage Topology
problem_solved: High-voltage ultracapacitor banks experience massive voltage imbalances across series-parallel cell strings, requiring bulky external component counts and causing high dissipation losses that reduce pack lifespans.
description: A highly efficient, ultra-compact cascaded modular equalizer circuit designed to execute high-speed voltage balancing across matrix-connected ultracapacitor arrays without requiring localized passive balancing resistors, keeping component stress low.
applications: Electric vehicle powertrain systems, industrial micro-grid power backups, heavy-duty robotic power distribution, and renewable energy storage banks.
